message: Magic Control Pro v2.4 is available with the new Force application and six hidden Force-enabled Notes presets.
notes: Magic Control Pro v2.4 adds the standalone Force PWA at /force, six independent Force-enabled seed notes, hidden per-note list setup, persistent swap commands, local acknowledgements and the approved F app icon. Existing Magic Control, Calculator, Notes, Peek, Wi-Fi/AP, beacon, BOOT, OLED and OTA architecture are preserved.
